title: Scooter 1945: Taipei Rush
summary: Ride a red scooter through Taipei’s breakfast rush. Thread between taxis and blue delivery trucks, fire twin headlamp pulses, and save your horn for the garbage truck’s final barrage.
summaryZhTW: 騎著紅色機車穿過臺北清晨的車陣，從計程車和藍色小貨車之間鑽過，用雙束車燈開路。聽見垃圾車的旋律時，記得把喇叭留給最後一波攻勢。
coverAlt: Cream lettering reads “Scooter 1945” above “Taipei Rush.” A helmeted rider on a red scooter heads into a Taipei street full of yellow taxis and blue trucks.
controls: Steer with arrow keys, WASD, or touch and drag. Use Space or Horn to clear nearby traffic. P or Escape pauses the ride.

approval.note: Creator requested game publication and deployment of the titled card to the Possibility Games catalog.
